certification.method: hashlib.sha256 streamed in 4 MiB blocks; no size threshold, no skipping

reason: VertigoDataTier reached 40 GiB, exactly the fail-closed reserve the HPAC and renderer producers refuse below, while a 3.66 GB cold parse-back was writing. Certify-and-move, never delete (MAIN 2026-09-11).
